pm_note: Surplus moves with the sign of surplus DV01. Higher reinvestment rates help the funding balance. If surplus fell, shorten assets or add pay-fixed swaps; if it rose, the book was short duration.
Short-duration books lose surplus as liability PV rises faster than assets; reinvestment income falls. Extend the long end with STRIPS or add receive-fixed swaps, and watch MBS contraction.
Hurts books that are long the long end relative to liabilities (net positive 20Y/30Y key rate DV01). Trim 30Y STRIPS / long corporates toward the 10Y-20Y buckets where liabilities sit.
Mark-to-market loss scales with HY market value times spread duration; liabilities do not move. Review the weakest B names, keep HY under the 10% NAIC 3+ limit after any downgrades.
Hurts books that are short the long end relative to liabilities. Add 20Y/30Y duration (STRIPS or receive-fixed swaps) funded from the 2Y-5Y bucket.
Mark-to-market only; book yield is unchanged and liabilities do not move. Usually a hold or add decision for a buy-and-hold insurer, unless the move signals downgrades.
Long spread duration of CMBS / CLO mezzanine drives the loss. Check whether CLO tranches stay above the thin-tranche and designation thresholds before adding.
Every 2.C becomes 3.A, a fallen angel that now counts toward the HY limit. Expect a capital jump; sell or hedge the weakest BBB- names before the downgrade if spreads already price it.
Severe case: all BBB-family holdings become NAIC 3.A. HY limit breach is likely; the forced-sale decision vs a temporary limit waiver drives realized losses.
Income and expected cash flows fall; no mark-to-market in this model (spreads held). Reduce B-rated exposure and rely on IG / structured carry.
Contraction: MBS cash comes back early and is reinvested at lower forwards. Funding improves but long-end duration falls; extend with STRIPS or receivers.
Extension: MBS duration lengthens and early funding falls. Check years 1-10 funding and trim MBS if the balance approaches zero.
Surrenders are paid at the reserve value, so PV barely moves, but cash leaves early. Watch the years 1-5 funding balance; keep short Treasuries / ABS as a liquidity buffer.
Rates down, spreads wider and downgrades at once: the short-duration position and the credit position lose together. Receive-fixed swaps address the first; cutting BBB- / HY addresses the second.
